# MeCollage

> MeCollage is a free in-browser collage maker and image toolset. Photos are processed on the device and never uploaded: no signup, no watermark.

## Collage maker
- [Collage Maker](https://www.mecollage.top/): 6 aspect ratios, custom grids, filters, text and stickers; up to 20 photos.
- [Free Collage Maker](https://www.mecollage.top/free-collage-maker/): free photo collage without signup or watermark.
- [Combine Images](https://www.mecollage.top/combine-images/): put photos side by side, stack them into one long image, or build a grid; localized examples for zh/ja/es.
- [Split Image](https://www.mecollage.top/split-image/): cut one image into 2×2, 3×3 or strips and download every tile as a ZIP.
- [Batch Compress](https://www.mecollage.top/batch-compress/): resize a set, cap each file at a KB target and download one ZIP.
- [Square Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/square-collage/): 1:1 square collages for feeds and profiles.
- [Vertical Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/vertical-collage/): 9:16 and tall collages for stories and long screenshots.
- [Instagram Story Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/instagram-story-collage/): story-size collage layout.
- [Birthday Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/birthday-collage-maker/): birthday photo collage maker.
- [Wedding Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/wedding-collage-maker/): wedding photo collage maker.
- [Christmas Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/christmas-collage-maker/): Christmas collage with layouts, stickers and export presets.
- [How to Make a Collage](https://www.mecollage.top/how-to-make-a-collage/): step-by-step guide.
- [Social Media Image Sizes](https://www.mecollage.top/social-media-image-sizes/): size chart and size finder.

## Tools
- [Square Image](https://www.mecollage.top/tools/square/): make a photo square without cropping.
- [Square Crop](https://www.mecollage.top/tools/squarecrop/): crop to 1:1.
- [Rounded Corners](https://www.mecollage.top/tools/roundedcorners/): add rounded corners.
- [Blurred Frame](https://www.mecollage.top/tools/blurredframe/): blurred background frame.
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://www.mecollage.top/tools/aspectratiocalculator/): convert and calculate aspect ratios.
